summary: Social-first field reports: OpenAI agent safety fallout leads, vendor product pushes (DeepSeek, Dots), and multiple operator/workflow posts about harnesses, browser-integrations, and agent eval gaps. | Vendor releases and infra updates: OpenAI GPT-6 guide, Cloudflare Web Search API, AWS MCP expansion and Bedrock AgentCore integrations; E2B/Daytona sandbox advances and two GHSA security advisories. Includes operator-facing how-tos (Vercel, AWS Quick pattern). | GitHub-OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Cloudflare, Microsoft, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic), major infra updates (trycua/cua, openrig, ModelContextProtocol); many single-repo agent tools need corroboration and some repos look like low-quality/noise. | Package-centric snapshot: several high-download mainstream vendor packages (OpenAI, Salesforce, Redis, Vercel) plus a raft of MCP/memory/eval primitives; no social/user-workflow reports in this shard.
